basic_info.description: Welcome to Penthouse 3 at Union House, a stunning example of luxury living in San Francisco's prestigious Pacific Heights neighborhood. This newly constructed 41-unit condo complex offers an exclusive opportunity to own a piece of sophistication and style. Situated on the top 7th floor, this beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Penthouse boasts an upgraded kitchen complete with a central island, seamlessly flowing into a spacious family room and living area. This open-concept space is perfect for both relaxation and entertaining guests. A staircase from the entryway leads you to an expansive roof deck terrace, offering breathtaking views of Russian Hill and the vibrant city skyline. Pristine and never before occupied, Penthouse 3 is one of the final three penthouses available for sale at Union House, making it a rare find for discerning buyers seeking elegance and modernity in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. Don't miss the chance to own this exclusive residence.
